hearth.repair.say.player.1: Who goes about breaking the %1$s %2$s? I'd like a word with them.
hearth.repair.say.player.2: Look at the %1$s %2$s. Vandals. Well, it won't mend itself.
hearth.repair.say.explosion.1: Half the %1$s %2$s, gone in a bang. Fetch the barrow.
hearth.repair.say.explosion.2: Something blew a hole in the %1$s %2$s. I'll patch it.
hearth.repair.say.fire.0: The fire took the %1$s %2$s. We'll have it back.
hearth.repair.say.fire.1: Still smells of smoke. Right, the %1$s %2$s first.
hearth.repair.say.fire.2: Charred through, the %1$s %2$s. New timber, then.
hearth.repair.say.other.0: The %1$s %2$s has come loose. I'll see to it.
hearth.repair.say.other.1: Now where did that go? The %1$s %2$s wants mending.
hearth.repair.say.other.2: A gap in the %1$s %2$s. Won't take a moment.
hearth.repair.say.litter.0: Who left this in the way at the %s? Clear it, then.
hearth.repair.say.litter.1: Can't have folk climbing over rubbish to get into the %s.
hearth.repair.say.inspect_found: Someone's been at the %s. I'll get my tools.
hearth.repair.say.fire_alarm.1: Buckets! Everyone, buckets, to the well!
hearth.repair.say.fire_alarm.2: It's spreading! Form a line, quick!
hearth.repair.say.fire_out.1: That's the last of it. We'll rebuild.
hearth.repair.dialogue.news.fire: %s: "Can't you see the smoke? Grab a bucket!"
hearth.repair.dialogue.news.blocks: %s: "%s blocks to put back about town. We'll get to them."
hearth.repair.dialogue.cannot_pay: You haven't the coin for the mending.
hearth.repair.dialogue.paid: %s: "Paid in full. We'll start on it straight away."
hearth.repair.command.no_plot: You are not standing in a building of this settlement.
hearth.repair.command.nothing_owed: Nothing of yours in %s needs mending.
hearth.repair.command.quote: Mending %s blocks of your property in %s will cost %s.
hearth.repair.command.paid: Paid %s; the builders will mend %s blocks.
